description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center. This pivotal role involves overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. If you are a compassionate leader with a commitment to excellence, we encourage you to apply.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in maintaining regulatory compliance, developing nursing policies, and implementing best practices to enhance resident outcomes. This is an excellent opportunity for a visionary leader to make a significant impact within a dynamic healthcare setting. We are offering a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year for this vital position.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Proven experience in a nursing leadership or management role, preferably as a Director of Nursing
Experience working in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
